column1: # A typed line's name and Menge (job 61): app/lib/list/entry.dart parseEntry and the server's
# public.parse_item read every row the same (tested by app/test/list/entry_test.dart and the db
# gate's supabase/functions/_shared/add_paths_integration_test.ts), offline as online. Up front,
# an amount or a number word of supabase/tests/number_words.tsv (German or English, job 104) is
# the Menge, unless the line starts with a name there ("Drei Glocken"). A bare count at the end,
# digits or a number word but no article form ("Milch ein"), is the Menge only when it is 1 to
# 20, does not follow a size or unit word, and the rest is a word the dictionary knows or the
# household bought before (history). The server's name here is its name and Eigenschaften joined
# ("Windeln" + "Größe 4"). Tab-separated; an empty cell is none.
# Said is different (job 89): the voice splitter (supabase/functions/voice/parse.ts, parse_en.ts;
# Siri, Alexa, in-app dictation) reads any count said after the item as the Menge, as a word or
# digits. A row with mode `typed` is only typed, one with `spoken` only said; no mode is both.
# lang is the splitter a said row goes through: de (none) or en.
